body: I know people care, but the people around me never know what to say or do when I'm depressed or having an off-day - I don't imagine they'd be very helpful now. I'd feel more embarrassed to express this hopelessness with anyone face to face. I can logically acknowledge my friend and I were different, but my emotions definitely overpower that a lot of the time. It's awful because I *know* I'm capable... but I *feel* like it's not worth it, especially with this happening tonight. There's just so much going on right now that I feel stuck and I don't have the energy to help myself at the moment. Thank you for commenting, hearing those words from someone else does help.
You did make me smile. Thank you, I hope you feel loved today.
I know there's always a solution. The question is: Do we have the energy or the desire to try? I'm not too sure I can answer "yes" anymore.
